THIS IS NOT A CNC CUT FILE.
Create the production panel only after the
1. All dimensions are millimetres. Do not scale from on-screen display. 2. “Exact” on D1 means copied from the named manufacturer source, not tolerance-certified metrology.
3. Pioneer effective display area is intentionally separate from the nose envelope; published documentation does not locate it from the external edges. 4. Nose and chassis depth are not summed.
5. Dashboard photographs are visual references only. The retained glovebox, speedometer, factory top line and factory straight bottom line must be traced directly before any panel perimeter is drawn.
Component/package dimensional control — not production release
